sources.excerpt: Further rights of persons registered in HIS The right to object to further processing and the right to erasure, rectification, restriction of processing and data transfer of all of the individual's own data stored in HIS: if the requirements for registration are not met or if registered data is incorrect, the registered person may file a legal request for erasure or correction with the registering insurance company.
